visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A toddler girl with short pigtails and bangs, wearing a black sweatshirt with a blue graphic, sits at a wooden table in a bright modern kitchen. She waves her hands excitedly and looks towards the camera with a wide-eyed, expectant expression. (2) The camera cuts to a slightly older girl with bangs wearing a tan quilted vest over a white shirt, holding a pink straw cup. She sits at the same table and speaks toward the camera with a calm, friendly face. (3) The scene shifts back to the toddler, who is now holding a green and yellow straw cup. She drinks the liquid greedily with a focused, serious look. When a hand approaches, she quickly pulls the cup away and turns her head, exhibiting a protective gesture. (4) The toddler eventually looks at the camera and extends the green cup forward as if offering a drink. She has a subtle smile and a soft facial expression, while the woman in the background moves slightly out of focus.

(2) Vocal pitch remains high but shifts to a different child speaker. The BGM remains constant and playful. (3) A soft 'clink' of plastic and suction sounds accompany the child drinking. A female adult voice in the background speaks at a lower pitch with moderate arousal. (4) The toddler shouts loudly with high vocal tension and rising intonation. A 'whoosh' transition sound effect marks a camera cut. (5) A final bright jingle with synthesizer sparkles plays as the video ends, overlapping with the final child's exclamation.
